description: v10.3 Instructional Injection. Implements Hybrid RAG (Chroma+BM25), Pydantic validation, centralized prompts, and new resilience patterns (retries, circuit breakers, context budgeting).

v10_3_changes: OVERWRITE: Destructive overwrite based on Instructional_Injection_Enhanced_v4.md.
RAGStack: Replaced ReAct RAG with a Hybrid RAG pipeline (ChromaDB + BM25) for superior retrieval.
Resilience: Added @exponential_backoff_retry to all graph nodes.
Resilience: Added CircuitBreakers to all tool calls in ReAct conductors.
Resilience: Added ContextBudgetManager to QAConductor to prevent token errors.
Validation: All LLM outputs now validated against Pydantic models defined in core_v10_3.
Prompts: All 30+ prompts removed from agents/tools and centralized in PromptTemplateManager.
DI: Removed all global CONFIG singletons. True DI enforced in main.py and run_batch.py.

gap_closure.RAGStack: Upgraded from pure vector to Hybrid RAG (Vector + Keyword) with parallel execution and reranking.
gap_closure.Resilience: Gaps closed by adding node-level retries and tool-level circuit breakers.
gap_closure.Context: Gap closed by adding a ContextBudgetManager to prune large documents.
gap_closure.Validation: Gap closed by implementing Pydantic models and a central ResponseValidator.
gap_closure.Prompting: Gap closed by eradicating hardcoded prompts and centralizing them in PromptTemplateManager.

instructional_techniques_applied.implementation: All 30+ prompts moved to PromptTemplateManager in core_v10_3.
All 15 specialist tool prompts now include few-shot examples.
All 30+ LLM outputs validated by ResponseValidator against Pydantic models.
DraftingRefinerTool and PromptEngineerAgent now inject a `style_guide`.
RAG_SearchAgent now runs ChromaDB (vector) + BM25 (keyword) in parallel.
ReActConductor and QAConductor wrap all tool calls in a CircuitBreaker.
QAConductor uses ContextBudgetManager.prune() on large documents.
Global CONFIG singletons removed from main.py and run_batch.py.
